# Spatial Biomass_core reference

Captured from `scripts/landis_spatial_reference.R` on 2026-11-14.

- R 4.3.3
- LandR 1.2.0.9064
- SpaDES.core 3.2.1.9067
- Biomass_core commit `21b3392324c2787a47751be808cbf9e595f308c0`
- 10 × 10 landscape at 100 m, 100 pixels
- two species, two pixel groups, one ecoregion
- 10-year horizon, 10-year succession timestep
- fixed R seed `20261114`
- two independent runs produced byte-identical output

The run is a small spatial reference, not a regional LBSE reproduction.
